name: 48385-fixed1k1k-dsv4flash-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 -- one whole a3 node (--gres=gpu:8), driver 570.195.03, nothing else on the cards.
parallelism: TP=8, expert parallelism on, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine: 32 whole experts and 18.6 GiB of weights per rank, in-node NVLink only -- no all-to-all transport, no KV connector, no offload tier.
architecture: DeepseekV4ForCausalLM: 43 MoE layers, hidden 4096, bf16 activations, 256 routed plus 1 shared expert at moe_intermediate_size 2048, 6 experts per token, MXFP4 expert weights over a block-FP8 base, compressed-KV attention, yarn rope. 148.6 GiB across 46 safetensors shards; public and ungated. Shapes read off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 256 (pinned, not searched), warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 512 requests -- two closed-loop passes of the 256 streams -- with a 3600 s safety cap. The warmup count truncates, leaving ~461 scored records.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, fixed 1024 prompt / 1024 output tokens (min = max = nominal on both), `temperature: 0.0`, seed 48385; the output length is exact because guidellm sets `max_tokens` and `ignore_eos=True`. The engine runs IN PROCESS through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend, so no HTTP server is on the path.
purpose: A long-context writing assistant on a large mixture-of-experts model, serving 256 concurrent single-turn requests across eight GPUs.
launch:
# The engine is pinned to a commit, so the interpreter is named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`
# rather than by a released wheel version.
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash

# The whole node, with the 256 routed experts distributed whole rather than sliced eight ways.
tensor-parallel-size: 8
enable-expert-parallel: true

# 1024 prompt + 1024 output = 2048 exactly, the longest request this workload can produce.
max-model-len: 2048

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# REQUIRED, not a tuning choice: this checkpoint's attention layer asserts
# `kv_cache_dtype.startswith("fp8")` and refuses to construct under the default `auto`.
kv-cache-dtype: fp8_ds_mla

# PINNED, and a genuine runner hazard: an in-process engine build is in neither per-context default
# table and falls through to 2048 / 128, and 128 is below the 256 concurrent streams this setup
# declares, which would silently halve the running batch.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
